status: Prospectively fixed independent internal holdout; no fresh-question model outcome yet
sources: HotpotQA official train; 2Wiki official dev; MuSiQue answerable train. Internal held-out test, not official test. No fitting on selected questions.
eligibility: Exclude all consumed normalized questions and all prior MuSiQue decomposition IDs. Within selected MuSiQue no decomposition ID is shared. Preserve eligible hop proportions via fixed quotas, selecting higher-hop strata first; no gold outcome selection.
method: Exactly V24 native-cap title-linked expansion and window; complete regex source segments; seed retained; no method/budget changes after new outcomes.
primary: Equal-dataset mean of per-question EM(linked)-EM(window), averaged over both readers and allowances128/256/512. One primary contrast; no per-cell selection.
primary_test: Two-sided question-clustered sign-flip randomization with100000 draws, seed20261111, preserving all six outcomes in each question and dataset weights. Monte Carlo p=(extreme+1)/(100000+1). Alpha0.05. Report signed effect and10000-draw stratified question-paired bootstrap95%interval regardless of sign/p.
secondary: F1 counterpart; all dataset/reader/budget scores and paired effects; native-cap seed, LLMLingua-2, full20, excerpt20, closed-book comparisons descriptive. No new confirmatory significance claims from these secondary cells.
conditions_per_reader: At b128/256/512: linked,window,llmlingua2. At b0: seed,raw20,excerpt20,closed_book. 26outputs/question across2readers;117000total.
upstream: Original four-search Qwen controller, depth60 dense+BM25, fixed hybrid40 BGE reranking and top5persearch (20slots); original relevance seed extraction; no gold labels accessible to inference.
compression: Same official LLMLingua-2 package/checkpoint and input-only cap calibration as V26; complete source20slots, native cap=seed prompt length+b; no output-based tuning.
reader: Same pinned Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B revisions; bfloat16 vLLM0.11.2; temperature0 seed42 max96; same recorded replica for every condition of a reader/question.
failure: Three client attempts only for unsuccessful requests. Valid wrong/empty/length-stopped answers retained. Upstream request failure yields zero for all dependent methods; independent closed-book still evaluated when possible. Invalid seed selection retains original fallback. No efficacy stopping, exclusions, replacement questions, or optional sample-size extension.
power: At N1500each across3datasets, transferring the previous two-dataset six-condition average variance gives approximate80%MDE0.82pp (1pp power>80%). This is a pilot projection, not a guarantee: MuSiQue/train population variance is unknown; per-reader/budget comparisons are secondary and not separately powered. Do not count six reader/budget repetitions as independent questions.
execution: Smoke uses six previously consumed questions. Freeze source/model/data identities after operational smoke before any test rollout. Complete all4500reserved questions. Retain any original failures and operational amendments.
decision: A positive primary effect supports only this fixed averaged estimand. Assess usefulness against seed/uncompressed/compression baselines and full ablations; no blanket superiority or necessary-tier claim. If not reproduced, do not submit as established performance-improving method.
publication: No external upload, paid service, email or journal submission as part of this run.
